g.text: Bob publishes the key bundle to the server containing:
• Verify all the signatures on the prekeys
• Generates a pqkem encapsulated shared secret (SS)
AD that contains identity information for
• The PQKEM ciphertext CT encapsulating SS for PQPKB
Identifiers stating which of Bob’s prekeys Alice used
- DH1 = DH(SPKB_priv, IKA_pub) ← Same as Alice's DH(IKA_priv, SPKB_pub)
- DH2 = DH(IKB_priv, EKA_pub) ← Same as Alice's DH(EKA_priv, IKB_pub)
- DH3 = DH(SPKB_priv, EKA_pub) ← Same as Alice's DH(EKA_priv, SPKB_pub)
and pqkem prekeys to a server.
